item.text:
Implemented the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes all four navigation views, 12 sample courses, catalog search and filters, a registration form with a confirmation modal, and a profile schedule table. Registrations are saved in the browser with `localStorage`. Accessibility features include a skip link, labeled controls, keyboard focus styles, live updates, and a mobile navigation toggle.

`node --check app.js` passed. I couldn’t run a browser-based interaction check because no browser executable is available in the environment.
